# LSASS Credential Theft - Master Composite (L3)

**Tactic:** Credential Access (TA0006) · **ATT&CK:** [T1003.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/001/) · [T1003.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/002/)  
**Status:** 🧪 In validation (1/1 passing)  
**Data:** `DeviceProcessEvents`, `DeviceFileEvents`, `DeviceEvents` · **Platforms:** Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting, Microsoft Sentinel (MDE connector) · **Production lookback:** 7d  
**Rule:** [`COMPOSITE_L3_LSASS_CREDENTIAL_THEFT_MASTER.kql`](COMPOSITE_L3_LSASS_CREDENTIAL_THEFT_MASTER.kql) · **Author:** Ala Dabat

## Minimum truth

> LSASS memory is touched or dumped: a dump command (comsvcs MiniDump, a known dumping tool), an LSASS dump file written, or a process handle opened on lsass.exe.

## Reinforcement

Multiple independent signals converging on the same host and account; LOLBin (comsvcs) usage.

## Known coverage boundaries

Documented cases where this implementation of the technique does not produce the rule's minimum truth. They run on every build and will report when a rule change closes the gap.

- **`test_benign.yml`**: convergence counts events (count() > 1), not distinct signal types - routine LSASS handle access by svchost/services crosses the threshold
